notes.title: The game is on - we have a global leaderboard!
notes.content:
Fresh out of the oven:

- Global leaderboard
- 10 Achievements
- Combo counter & score multiplier (will reset if you are hit)
- The game can now be paused anytime by pressing the menu button
- Score will reset if you die

  
We are working hard on the following features:

- More levels
- More enemy types
- Complete pause menu with settings, leaderboard, etc...
- More game modes


Cheers,
Team Grumpy
